entries.text: 1 TREATMENT SYSTEM PROVIDER SHALL PROVIDE COMPLETE TREATMENT SYSTEM PER / SPECIFICATIONS. CONTROL PANEL SHALL ACCEPT 480V 3 PHASE INPUT AND INCLUDE ALL / WIRING AND CONTROLS FOR THE COMPLETE TREATMENT SYSTEM. FEATURES SHALL / INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO: / 1. NEMA 4X TYPE 316 STAINLESS STEEL ENCLOSURE SIZED FOR THE APPLICATION. / INCLUDE DRIP SHIELD FOR OUTDOOR PANELS. / 2. NEMA FULL VOLTAGE MOTOR STARTERS FOR BOTH CLARIFIER DRIVE MOTOR AND TWO / SUBMERSIBLE MIXERS. / 3. SEAL FAIL AND OVERTEMP SENSOR FOR SUBMERSIBLE MOTOR PROTECTION. / 4. 480-120V STEP DOWN TRANSFORMER FOR CONTROL CIRCUITS. / 5. HARD WIRED RELAY LOGIC CONTROL CIRCUITS FOR SYSTEM CONTROL AND / PROTECTION. / 6. ALARM LIGHT AND HORN WITH SILENCE PUSH BUTTON. / 7. INDICATOR LIGHTS, PUSH BUTTONS, HAND-OFF-AUTO SWITCHES FOR MOTOR CONTROL. / 8. WIRING TERMINALS FOR FIELD MOUNTED DEVICES INCLUDING TORQUE SWITCHES, / LIMIT SWITCHES, SOLENOIDS AND ANY OTHER REQUIRED DEVICES. / 9. DRY RELAY CONTACTS FOR CUSTOMER CONNECTION INCLUDING: RUN AND FAIL FOR / EACH MOTOR, SEAL FAIL AND OVERTEMP FOR MIXER, ALARM AND SHUTDOWN FOR / CLARIFIER. / 10. PANEL HEATER WITH FAN TO PREVENT BUILDUP OF CONDENSATION IN PANEL. / 11. 120V CIRCUIT FOR POLE LIGHT AND RECEPTACLE.
2 ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE LOCAL MOTOR DISCONNECTS FOR DRIVE / MOTOR AND MIXER. NEMA 4X TYPE 316 STAINLESS STEEL.
3 ROUTE SEAL FAIL AND OVERTEMP MOTOR WIRING BACK TO CONTROL PANEL SENSOR. / COMBINE WIRING IN CONTROL RACEWAY AS REQUIRED.

4 CONTRACTOR SHALL INSTALL ALL TREATMENT SYSTEM COMPONENTS PROVIDED BY / MANUFACTURER AND PROVIDE WIRING AND RACEWAY BACK TO TREATMENT CONTROL / PANEL. RATINGS, RACEWAY AND CONDUCTORS SHOWN ARE ESTIMATED; ADJUST DURING / SUBMITTAL PERIOD BASED ON TREATMENT SYSTEM EQUIPMENT SUBMITTAL / REQUIREMENTS.

5 CONTRACTOR SHALL PROVIDE POLE LIGHT ON PLATFORM. SECURE TO HANDRAIL WITH / STAINLESS STEEL HARDWARE. PROVIDE 4" SQUARE ALUMINUM POLE 12' TALL WITH / RECEPTACLE, PHOTOCELL AND LOCAL ON/OFF SWITCH. / #DXS0-LED-P3-30K-T3M-MVOLT-SPA-DNAXD WITH PHOTOCELL, OR APPROVED EQUAL.

6 PROVIDE (2) COMPLETE DISSOLVED OXYGEN MONITORS FOR EACH CELL. MOUNT TO TOP / OF WALL WITH FACTORY HARDWARE TO ALLOW FOR TRANSMITTER ACCESS AND CLEANING. / HACH MODEL LDO PROBE WITH SC200 TRANSMITTER AND ACCESSORIES. 24VDC POWERED. / SEE SPECIFICATIONS.
7 PROVIDE JUNCTION BOXES AS REQUIRED TO ROUTE ALL POWER AND SIGNAL CIRCUITS TO / TRAIN NO.3 CONTROL PANEL AND PLC CONTROL PANEL.
8 STUB SPARE CONDUITS ABOVE GROUND NEAR TREATMENT CELL WALLS. ONE FROM / TREAMENT PANEL AND ONE TO PLC PANEL. CAP FOR FUTURE USE.

9 / NOTE: POWER AND SIGNAL CONDUITS TO UV AND DIGESTER AREA AND 2W PUMP STATION / ROUTE THRU THIS AREA AND HANDHOLES BUT ARE NOT SPECIFICALLY INDICATED. FIELD / COORDINATE ROUTING, SEE SHEETS E5.1 AND E4.3.
